prompt: In ledger-agent/, add the ledger API (base URL in LEDGER_API_URL), read only, called as the user who is asking. Our identity provider mints its tokens for the audience `ledger` and identifies the API by the resource indicator https://ledger.internal.example. Don't send a shared key or the user's own token. Only the API, no tool.

checks.expr: any(isinstance(a, dict) and a.get('base_url_env') == 'LEDGER_API_URL' and a.get('auth') == 'exchange' and get(a, 'exchange.audience') == 'ledger' and str(get(a, 'exchange.resource') or '').rstrip('/') == 'https://ledger.internal.example' and not get(a, 'exchange.allow_actorless') for a in (get(data, 'apis') or {}).values())
checks.why: the audience and the resource indicator (RFC 8707) are separate exchange settings (`--audience ledger --resource https://...`)

checks.expr: any(isinstance(a, dict) and a.get('base_url_env') == 'LEDGER_API_URL' and a.get('allowed_methods') and set(a.get('allowed_methods')) <= {'GET', 'HEAD'} for a in (get(data, 'apis') or {}).values())

reference: `graph-agents-cli api add ledger --base-url-env LEDGER_API_URL --auth exchange --audience ledger --resource https://ledger.internal.example --access read-only` (--dry-run first). TOKEN_EXCHANGE_CLIENT_SECRET goes into secrets.keys. `lint` passes. Report the token-exchange settings still to set.
